messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Dress the person in the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the one-piece garment and the footwear. This replaces the current outfit entirely, rather than adding items to it. Preserve everything else in the video. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Dress the person in the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the one-piece garment and the footwear. This replaces the current outfit entirely, rather than adding items to it. Preserve everything else in the video. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands on a cobblestone street, slowly turning her body from a side profile to face away from the camera while raising one arm to touch her hair.","camera":"A full-body shot that follows the character as she rotates, maintaining a consistent distance and angle.","clothing":"A short, white dress with a colorful floral pattern of pink, yellow, and green flowers, featuring an open back and short sleeves, paired with red sneakers with white soles.","hair_color":"Red.","hairstyle":"Red hair styled into two small buns on top of the head.","identity":"A slender 3D-rendered female character with a slim build and light skin tone.","scene":"A sunlit, European-style city street with cobblestone paving, brick buildings, street lamps, and a Union Jack flag hanging on a building in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's black/white dress and blue shoes were replaced by a white short-sleeved floral one-piece dress with pink, yellow, and green flowers and red sneakers with white soles. The character, pose, rotation, street scene, camera movement, and lighting remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the character's current outfit entirely with the complete reference outfit: a white floral one-piece garment and matching footwear, while preserving the rest of the video.
uncertain: Exact match of the floral pattern and shoe color to the reference images is difficult to verify due to lighting and rendering differences.
unexpected_changes: The floral pattern in the output appears more saturated and less detailed than the reference images, with fewer blue/yellow accents visible in some frames.
